name: Supreme Courtship
source:
The world's first judicial friendship simulator!

In Supreme Courtship, begin your journey as the newly appointed 9th Justice on the Supreme Court. Navigate through the American justice system, solve a political murder mystery, and hang out with the young, stylish members of the Court - all while trying to learn just what Justice means to you!

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190612083902/https://www.supremecourtship.com/]official site[/url]]
translation:
世界上第一款司法友谊模拟游戏！

在《最高法院求爱》中，你将以新任命的最高法院第9位大法官身份开始旅程。探索美国司法体系，解决一宗政治谋杀谜案，与法院里年轻时尚的成员们一起消磨时光，同时努力弄清“正义”对你意味着什么！

[来源：[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190612083902/https://www.supremecourtship.com/]官方网站[/url]]
